title: Beyond Dictation — Enhanced Voice-Control for macOS apps
description: Using the native speech recognition capabilities of macOS you can dictate a letter, message, or perform command and control actions like launching and switching between apps, finding and creating documents, and more; But even more is possible when you combine dictation with built-in automation technologies of macOS to create personalized, voice-triggered, workflows. Learn how to dynamically create dictation command sets for yourself, your application, and your customers.
